original: bho vādinau ! eṣā vivādādhyāsitānaṅgasenā jayaparājayaṃ yāvat madhyasthasthāne sthāpyatām | evaṃvidhe ca mādhyasthye vayam eva nṛpativyavasthitā madhyasthāḥ |
